description: This Java test class `RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilderDatetimeTest` contains JUnit tests for the `RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder` class, focusing on the methods related to rendering date and time form elements, specifically datetime fields. It uses mocking frameworks to simulate dependencies and verifies the generated macros for different datetime configurations.
